arxiv-1911-05415.creator: Conceptual issues in cosmology
arxiv-1911-05415.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Conceptual issues in cosmology. Colin MacLaurin BMath (Hons I), Grad Dip Theol Under the supervision of Prof. Tamara Davis A thesis submitted to the University of Queensland in partial fulfilment of the degree of Master of Science Faculty of Science School of Mathematics and Physics June 2015 Abstract I examine the interpretation of photon redshifts in curved spacetime, as being gravitational or Doppler in origin.

arxiv-2102-09577.title: The TW Hya Rosetta Stone Project IV: A hydrocarbon rich disk atmosphere
arxiv-2102-09577.creator: L. Ilsedore Cleeves, Ryan A. Loomis, Richard Teague, Edwin A. Bergin, David J. Wilner, Jennifer B. Bergner, Geoffrey A. Blake, Jenny K. Calahan, Paolo Cazzoletti, Ewine F. van Dishoeck, Viviana V. Guzmán, Michiel R. Hogerheijde, Jane Huang, Mihkel Kama, Karin I. Öberg, Chunhua Qi, Jeroen Terwisscha
arxiv-2102-09577.description: Abstract Connecting the composition of planet-forming disks with that of gas giant exoplanet atmospheres, in particular through C/O ratios, is one of the key goals of disk chemistry. Small hydrocarbons like C 2 ​ H \rm C_{2}H and C 3 ​ H 2 \rm C_{3}H_{2} have been identified as tracers of C/O, as they form abundantly under high C/O conditions.

arxiv-2107-03264.title: The Ponzano-Regge cylinder and Propagator for 3d quantum gravity
arxiv-2107-03264.creator: Etera R. Livine
arxiv-2107-03264.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Etera R. Livine. We investigate the propagator of 3d quantum gravity, formulated as a discrete topological path integral. We define it as the Ponzano-Regge amplitude of the solid cylinder swept by a 2d disk evolving in time. Quantum states for a 2d disk live in the tensor products of N N spins, where N N is the number of holonomy insertions connecting to the disk boundary.

arxiv-2201-04875.title: Gluon transversity and TMDs for spin-1 hadrons
arxiv-2201-04875.creator: S. Kumano a,b and Qin-Tao Song c,d
arxiv-2201-04875.description: Abstract We explain a gluon transversity, transverse-momentum-dependent parton distribution functions (TMDs), and parton distribution functions (PDFs) for spin-1 hadrons. The gluon transversity exists in hadrons with spin more than or equal to one, and it does not exist in the spin-1/2 nucleons.

arxiv-2206-14055.title: Towards Lexical Gender Inference: A Scalable Methodology using Online Databases
arxiv-2206-14055.creator: Marion Bartl, Susan Leavy
arxiv-2206-14055.description: Abstract This paper presents a new method for automatically detecting words with lexical gender in large-scale language datasets. Currently, the evaluation of gender bias in natural language processing relies on manually compiled lexicons of gendered expressions, such as pronouns ( he , she , etc.) and nouns with lexical gender ( mother , boyfriend , policewoman , etc.).

arxiv-2209-08552.title: Parallel window decoding enables scalable fault tolerant quantum computation
arxiv-2209-08552.creator: Luka Skoric, Dan E. Browne, Kenton M. Barnes, Neil I. Gillespie, Earl T. Campbell
arxiv-2209-08552.description: Abstract Large-scale quantum computers have the potential to hold computational capabilities beyond conventional computers for certain problems. However, the physical qubits within a quantum computer are prone to noise and decoherence, which must be corrected in order to perform reliable, fault-tolerant quantum computations. Quantum Error Correction (QEC) provides the path for realizing such computations.

arxiv-2404-16754.title: RadGenome-Chest CT: A Grounded Vision-Language Dataset for Chest CT Analysis.
arxiv-2404-16754.creator: Xiaoman Zhang, Chaoyi Wu, Ziheng Zhao, Jiayu Lei, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie
arxiv-2404-16754.description: Abstract Developing generalist foundation model has recently attracted tremendous attention among researchers in the field of AI for Medicine (AI4Medicine). A pivotal insight in developing these models is their reliance on dataset scaling, which emphasizes the requirements on developing open-source medical image datasets that incorporate diverse supervision signals across various imaging modalities.

arxiv-2512-16152.title: Pulsar Science with the SKA Observatory
arxiv-2512-16152.creator: Bhal Chandra Joshi 1,2, Aris Karastergiou 3, Marta Burgay 4, The SKA pulsar science working group
arxiv-2512-16152.description: Abstract The large instantaneous sensitivity, a wide frequency coverage and flexible observation modes with large number of beams in the sky are the main features of the SKA observatory’s two telescopes, the SKA-Low and the SKA-Mid, which are located on two different continents.

arxiv-2601-13664.title: VIAFormer: Voxel-Image Alignment Transformer for High-Fidelity Voxel Refinement
arxiv-2601-13664.creator: Tiancheng Fang, Bowen Pan, Lingxi Chen, Jiangjing Lyu, Chengfei Lyu, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu
arxiv-2601-13664.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Tiancheng Fang, Bowen Pan, Lingxi Chen, Jiangjing Lyu, Chengfei Lyu, Chaoyue Niu, Fan Wu. We propose VIAFormer, a V oxel- I mage A lignment Trans- former model designed for Multi-view Conditioned Voxel Refinement—the task of repairing incomplete noisy voxels using calibrated multi-view images as guidance.

europmc-pmc7454922.title: Loneliness and Mental Health During the COVID-19 Pandemic: A Study Among Dutch Older Adults.
europmc-pmc7454922.creator: van Tilburg TG, Steinmetz S, Stolte E, van der Roest H, de Vries DH.
europmc-pmc7454922.description: Objectives With the spread of COVID-19, the Netherlands implemented a policy to keep citizens physically distanced. We hypothesize that consequent reduction in the frequency of social contacts, personal losses, and the experience of general threats in society reduced well-being.

pmc-10574450.title: Using Crowdsourced Food Image Data for Assessing Restaurant Nutrition Environment: A Validation Study
pmc-10574450.creator: Weixuan Lyu, Nina Seok, Xiang Chen, Ran Xu, Antonios Dakanalis
pmc-10574450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Crowdsourced online food images, when combined with food image recognition technologies, have the potential to offer a cost-effective and scalable solution for the assessment of the restaurant nutrition environment. While previous research has explored this approach and validated the accuracy of food image recognition technologies, much remains unknown about the validity of crowdsourced food images as the primary data source for large-scale assessments.

pmc-10743973.title: Dynamics of Humic Acid, Silicon, and Biochar under Heavy Metal, Drought, and Salinity with Special Reference to Phytohormones, Antioxidants, and Melatonin Synthesis in Rice
pmc-10743973.creator: Arjun Adhikari, Appiah Gregory Aneefi, Hairkham Sisuvanh, Santivong Singkham, Masele Valentine Pius, Farida Akter, Eun-Hae Kwon, Sang-Mo Kang, Youn-Ji Woo, Byung-Wook Yun, In-Jung Lee, Małgorzata M Posmyk
pmc-10743973.description: This study aimed to develop a biostimulant formulation using humic acid (HA), silicon, and biochar alone or in combination to alleviate the lethality induced by combined heavy metals (HM-C; As, Cd, and Pb), drought stress (DS; 30–40% soil moisture), and salt stress (SS; 150 mM NaCl) in rice.

pmc-11479190.title: Performance Evaluation of Real-Time Kinematic Global Navigation Satellite System with Survey-Grade Receivers and Short Observation Times in Forested Areas
pmc-11479190.creator: Mihnea Cățeanu, Maria Alexandra Moroianu, Baocheng Zhang
pmc-11479190.description: The Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) method is currently the most widely used method for positioning using Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSSs) due to its accuracy, efficiency and ease of use. In forestry, position is a critical factor for numerous applications, with GNSS currently being the preferred solution for obtaining such data.

pmc-11674964.title: The Impact of Vaccination on COVID-19 Outcomes in Vietnam
pmc-11674964.creator: Ngoc-Lan Thi Nguyen, Hien Thi Thu Nguyen, Vang Le-Quy, Thu-Ba To, Huy Thinh Tran, Tuan Duc Nguyen, Yen Hoang, Anh-Thu Nguyen, Lan Thi Phuong Dam, Nhat-Linh Nguyen, Anh Tuan Dinh-Xuan, Thanh-Van Ta, Anna Baraniak
pmc-11674964.description: Objectives: This study aimed to assess the effectiveness of the COVID-19 vaccine on the outcomes of patients in three hospitals in Vietnam. Methods: An observational study involved 3102 confirmed COVID-19 patients from Vietnam. Participants were classified into unvaccinated, partially vaccinated (one dose) (PV), fully vaccinated (two doses) (FV), and boosted (three doses) groups.

pmc-12470172.title: Altered Neuroinflammatory Transcriptomic Profile in the Hippocampal Dentate Gyrus Three Weeks After Lateral Fluid Percussion Injury in Rats
pmc-12470172.creator: Anthony J. DeSana, Yara Alfawares, Roshni Khatri, Tracy M. Hopkins, Faith V. Best, Jennifer L. McGuire, Laura B. Ngwenya
pmc-12470172.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a major source of disability worldwide, with cognitive and memory deficits being pervasive after injury. The hippocampus, a major structure involved in learning and memory, is particularly vulnerable to TBI, and cellular dysfunction within the hippocampal dentate gyrus is believed to be a major contributor to cognitive deficits after TBI.

pmc-12654103.title: Investigation of the Effect of Contact Seal Geometry on Frictional Moment in Ball Bearings
pmc-12654103.creator: Paweł Zmarzły, Mateusz Wrzochal, Anna Rębosz-Kurdek, Silvio Genna
pmc-12654103.description: Due to their simple design and versatility, rolling bearings are widely used in various industrial and engineering applications. One of the key parameters characterizing ball bearings is the frictional moment (also referred to as resisting torque). Excessive torque values can increase energy consumption, which is undesirable from an energy efficiency standpoint.

pmc-12666520.title: Evaluating wildlife community composition around villages with varying Guinea worm (Dracunculus medinensis) transmission in Chad, Africa
pmc-12666520.creator: Avery L Korns, Karmen Unterwegner, Adam J Weiss, Philip Tchindebet Oaukou, Hubert Zirimwabagabo, Richard B Chandler, Dana J Morin, Michael J Yabsley, Christopher A Cleveland
pmc-12666520.description: Since 2012, Guinea worm (GW – Dracunculus medinensis) infections in animals have complicated the Guinea worm Eradication Program's (GWEP) goal to eradicate this parasite. Increased infections in domestic dogs (Canis lupus familiaris) and cats (Felis catus) have been a concern.

pmc-13451961.title: Efficacy of Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR) on Anxiety Severity Among Physicians and Nurses Working in Intensive Care Units
pmc-13451961.creator: Nastran Hatami, Mina Jouzi, Sara Kord, Behrooz Zarasvand
pmc-13451961.description: BackgroundPhysicians and nurses working in intensive care units (ICUs) are frequently exposed to emotionally demanding and high‐stress situations, placing them at increased risk for anxiety. Eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) has shown promise in reducing anxiety in various high‐stress populations; however, its effectiveness among ICU staff remains underexplored.
